therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: Non pegylated liposomal doxorubicin + trastuzumab + docetaxel
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: HER2 receptor antagonism combined with DNA intercalation and microtubule stabilization
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: HER2-driven tumor cell proliferation and survival
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Cardiotoxicity assessment including cardiac death, CHF, and LVEF decline
